pr_title: Use versioned URL for "Online Documentation" buttons in the editor
pr_body:
This also avoids a redirect, making the page appear to load faster.

This closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/58245.

issue_context.title: Godot 4: Online Docs option in script editor leads to stable documentation (3.x) instead of latest (4.0)
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0-alpha2

### System information

Windows 10 64-bit, GPU: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1650 Ti, CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 4800H

### Issue description

The "Online Docs" option in the Godot 4 script editor leads you to the [Godot stable docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/) (3.x) instead of the [Godot latest docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/) (4.0). This is just a minor inconvenience but still an inconvenience.

Of course this change will need to be reverted once 4.0 becomes stable.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Go to the script editor in Godot 4
2. Click on the "Online Docs" option at the top:
![Godot-OnlineDocsThingy](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/58695417/154514852-0a30146d-600f-4e0a-b408-b6d8303a3d13.png)
3. Verify the link:
Stable (3.x) Docs: `https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/`
Latest (4.0) Docs: `https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/` (What its should be)
Wheree you goo: `https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/`


### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_

review_comments: Is that trailing slash actually needed?

It's not strictly needed to get the page to load, but it seems to be needed to avoid a redirect:

```
❯ xh https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest
HTTP/2.0 302 Found
...
```

```
❯ xh https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/
HTTP/2.0 200 OK
...
```
